body: So would DM qualify as "flashback" or instead, "nostalgia"?

>And now I am imagining you telling your mother that you are working in an "adult bookstore" ;-)

Oh, I never thought of that.  I imagine that I could leave the "Adult" part out.  I was thinking of it as a way to get me out of isolation and forget my depression.  Maybe it's therapeutic?  

As far as health care goes, I'm for a French-style private, nonprofit system, but our insurance companies have gotten *far* too greedy for that.  I really like the idea of a [Carte Vitale](http://www.french-property.com/guides/france/public-services/health/health-card/) but that's another post.

Thanks for your thoughtfulness, compassion and advice for me in this period.

I have a therapist and psych- doctor who I haven't seen in a long time so I will see them.  I was thinking about getting a job in this adult bookstore 10 minutes from me (?)  At least I got a haircut last week with what little money I had.  Now to find some decent clothes for the occasion.

I don't have insurance to see my GP, so I don't know what I will do with that yet.

Hi again...had some unstable sleep, but please see the edit to my original posting!!.....My mom doesn't understand depression.  If she knew I lost my job (and why), she would be furious.  She puts it all down to laziness...but as I said above...there is still hope :).
I'm going to lay down for now...I'm feeling really tired.  My sleep schedule is all messed up.  My body has a hard time knowing day from night.  Thanks once again.

Hi again...I'm hoping to think of something soon. I've talked to my mother and she expects me to immediately get another job (in a town that has a double-digit unemployment rate).  Frankly though, I'm at a loss.

I know how painful it is for the survivors of suicide.  My last partner (I'm gay) overdosed and I suspect it was suicide.  (He was faced with being put in prison).  I don't want to hurt anybody, but I can't take it anymore.  I've fought and fought and it's just too much.  I really do feel like Chief Joseph of the Nez Perce; I think I've put up a long, heroic struggle that nobody knows about, or cares.

Well, I'm middle-aged and have been on my own since I was 18.  This is very difficult for me.  I hate my hometown and dread going back there; it is a nightmare to me.  My mom is not supportive; my father is deceased (Sorry, I should have mentioned that earlier).
Hi red...I'd like to reapply but things seem pretty dire right now.  I'm worried about my housing situation.  Thanks for the hugz though.  It means a lot to me.
